summary.text: Chadd Charland is a candidate with no party affiliation for the Florida House of Representatives, District 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Dean Black and write-in candidate Lloyd Caulker.
Ballotpedia lists his occupation as writer.

paragraphs.text: Charland earned a bachelor's degree from Auburn University in 1997, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived in Fernandina Beach since 2012 and had never run for office before.

He said his key messages were opposing data centers statewide, challenging developers to slow sprawl and protect rural and natural Florida, and seeking to reestablish home rule so local governments make more decisions affecting their residents.
He also named equity, the environment and public education as areas of policy interest, and said he opposes private school vouchers.
